science
科學
What everyday question would you like to investigate using science?
I would use science to explore which container keeps lunch warmest. Comparing the same meal under similar conditions would make the test useful.
我想用科學方法，看看哪種容器最能保溫。用相同餐點、接近的條件比較，測試才有參考性。
research
研究
How would you begin research into a topic you knew little about?
I would begin the research with a clear question and reliable introductory sources. Writing down uncertainties would help me avoid jumping to conclusions.
開始研究時，我會先定好問題，找可靠的入門資料。也寫下不確定的地方，不急著下結論。
experiment
實驗
What would you keep the same in an experiment comparing two plant foods?
In the experiment, I would keep water, light, and plant type similar. Changing several things together would make the results harder to interpret.
實驗時，我會盡量讓水量、光照和植物種類相近。一起改太多因素，就難以理解結果。
hypothesis
假設
What hypothesis could you test about your own study habits?
My hypothesis would be that a quieter room helps me recall more words. I would compare several sessions rather than judge from one good day.
我的假設是安靜房間能讓我記住更多單字。我會比較幾次練習，不只看某一天特別好的成績。
theory
理論
How would you explain why a scientific theory is more than a personal guess?
A scientific theory brings evidence together and offers testable explanations. That is different from an unsupported idea I simply happen to like.
科學理論會整合證據，提出能檢驗的解釋。這和我剛好喜歡、卻沒有根據的想法不同。
observe
觀察
How could you observe birds near your home without disturbing them?
I would observe the birds from the same quiet spot. Taking notes on time and weather would make later comparisons more useful.
我會在同一個安靜地點觀察鳥。記下時間和天氣，之後比較時也更有用。
measure
測量
What would you do before you measure a shelf for new furniture?
Before I measure the shelf, I would check where the edges begin and end. I would repeat the measurement before buying anything.
測量架子前，我會先確認兩端要從哪裡算。買家具之前，再量一次。
calculate
計算
How would you calculate the total cost of sharing a holiday apartment?
I would calculate rent, cleaning fees, and other shared charges first. Then we could agree whether different lengths of stay should affect each person's share.
我會先計算租金、清潔費和其他共同費用。再談住的天數不同，要不要影響分攤。
data
資料
What would you check before using data from an online chart?
I would check where the data came from and what was counted. A clear-looking chart can still leave out important context.
我會先查資料來源，以及到底統計了什麼。圖表再清楚，也可能漏掉重要背景。
analysis
分析
How could an analysis become misleading even if the numbers were copied correctly?
The analysis could compare groups that differ in important ways. Correct arithmetic would not fix a poorly chosen comparison.
分析如果拿差異很大的群體直接比較，就可能誤導。算術正確，也補不了比較方式不恰當。
result
結果
An unexpected result appears in a small test. What would you do next?
I would check the setup before treating the result as a discovery. Repeating the test could show whether it was a consistent pattern.
我會先檢查測試安排，不急著把結果當成新發現。再做幾次，看看是否持續出現。
conclusion
結論
What would make you cautious about a conclusion based on very few examples?
I would question whether the conclusion applied beyond those particular examples. A small sample might miss important differences in the wider group.
我會懷疑這個結論，能不能用在那些例子以外。樣本太少，可能漏看更大群體裡的重要差異。
variable
變數
Which variable would you change when testing how light affects a plant?
Light exposure would be the variable I deliberately changed. I would try to keep watering and plant size comparable between the groups.
我會刻意改變光照這個變數。澆水和植株大小，則盡量讓兩組接近。
precision
精確度
When might greater precision be worth the extra effort in a measurement?
Greater precision could matter when fitting a replacement part into a narrow space. For a rough room sketch, that extra effort might be unnecessary.
零件要裝進狹小空間時，更高精確度可能值得。如果只是畫房間草圖，就不必花那麼多力氣。
estimate
估計
How would you estimate how long a task will take when you have never done it before?
I would estimate the time by breaking the task into smaller parts. I would leave extra room for steps I did not yet understand.
我會先拆成小步驟，再估計時間。還不熟悉的部分，就多留一點空間。
uncertainty
不確定性
How would you communicate uncertainty when presenting a forecast?
I would explain the uncertainty and the assumptions behind the forecast. Giving a plausible range would be clearer than pretending one number was certain.
我會說明預測的不確定性和背後假設。提出合理範圍，比假裝一個數字一定正確更清楚。
probability
機率
Would a low probability of rain stop you from carrying an umbrella?
The probability alone would not decide it for me. If I had a long outdoor walk, carrying a light umbrella could still be sensible.
我不會只靠降雨機率決定。如果要在戶外走很久，帶把輕便傘仍然合理。
frequency
頻率
How would you compare the frequency of delays on two bus routes?
I would record the frequency of delays over similar periods. Comparing only one journey on each route could give a misleading impression.
我會在相近的期間記錄延誤頻率。兩條路線各搭一次，很容易得到不準的印象。
average
平均
Why might an average waiting time hide an important problem?
The average could hide a few extremely long waits. I would also look at the spread and how often people waited unusually long.
平均等待時間，可能掩蓋少數等特別久的情況。我也會看分布，以及異常久等多常發生。
pressure
壓力
How could you compare pressure in two tyres without relying on appearance?
I would check the pressure with a suitable gauge. Looking at the tyres alone would not give me a reliable numerical comparison.
我會用合適的壓力表檢查。只看輪胎外觀，得不到可靠的數值比較。
volume
容量
What would you measure to compare the volume of two irregular containers?
I could compare their volume by filling them with measured amounts of water. Their height alone would not tell me how much each holds.
我會用量好的水比較容量。只看容器高度，不知道各自到底裝得下多少。
material
材料
How would you choose a material for something that must be carried every day?
I would choose a material that balanced strength and weight. Testing a small sample would help reveal whether it scratched or bent easily.
我會選兼顧強度和重量的材料。先測小樣，看看會不會容易刮傷或彎曲。
structure
結構
What could a simple model reveal about the structure of a bridge?
A model could show how the structure carries a small load. I would still be cautious about assuming it represented a full-sized bridge perfectly.
模型可以呈現結構怎麼承受小負載。但不能直接假設，它完全代表實際大小的橋。
discovery
發現
How would you share a possible discovery before you were sure it was correct?
I would describe the discovery as preliminary and explain what I had checked. I would invite others to test it rather than announce certainty.
我會說明這只是初步發現，也交代檢查過什麼。邀請別人驗證，不急著宣布已經確定。
